target: A P0 native Capture Core with watcher-first startup and byte-for-byte behavior parity.
invariants: Capture Core depends only on Platform Foundation.
Watchers become active before startup enumeration and bounded catch-up.
Accepted events, raw bytes, cursors, ordering, and summary eligibility remain unchanged.
allowed_changes: Move native implementation into runtime, source, store, transaction, cursor, locking, and telemetry modules.
Add a thin dedicated Capture Core launcher and watcher-ready telemetry.
prohibited_changes: Change Summary V1, Summary V2, atomic summaries, historical backfill, or any cloud protocol.
Change source selection, visible-event normalization, persisted archive bytes, or cursor advancement semantics.
